standard.summary: 文本编码器输出磁盘缓存保存精度。
standard.whenToUse: 不确定时先保持默认，小步数短测后再调。
standard.avoidWhen: 与预检冲突或与其它互斥选项同时开启时。

optionDescriptions.fp32: 全精度文本缓存，占地方。

standard_en.summary: The precision the on-disk text encoder output cache is saved at.
standard_en.whenToUse: When unsure keep the default; run a short low-step test before changing it.
standard_en.avoidWhen: When it conflicts with preflight, or when a mutually exclusive option is enabled at the same time.

optionDescriptions.fp32: A full-precision text cache, which takes up space.

advanced.principle: 文本编码器输出磁盘缓存保存精度。auto 会尽量保留运行时 dtype；fp16 / bf16 更省空间，fp32 兼容性更高

advanced_en.principle: Storage precision for the text-encoder output disk cache. auto keeps the runtime dtype where possible; fp16 / bf16 save more space, fp32 is more compatible.
